unit: dataset company label; no parent-company substitution
coverage: 217 company labels, 88 candidate public histories, 71 usable 2022–2025 pairs and 35 usable 2019–2022 pairs
source_quality: Secondary compilation with partial primary checks; not a harmonized census
explanation_basis: All attributed reasons, including AI transition without further detail; matches narrative and explorer
method: Latest dated numeric observation within each calendar year; no imputation; net workforce growth, not hires. Unknown explanations remain a separate group. Known date errors excluded or corrected. Acquisitions not numerically adjusted.
